summary: The change adds per-article pending user saves, a draft snapshot, draft restoration after applying the response, and a queued follow-up save. The rapid administrator enable then disable scenario now restores the final checkbox selection and sends a second PATCH that persists it. No code defect was found, but no regression test was added.
